capabilities: Disable indented code blocks in Live Preview
Prefix indented lines with a zero-width non-joiner (U+200C) to keep indentation visible
Leave YAML frontmatter, fenced code blocks, lists, and blockquotes untouched
Apply the change automatically after edits in the editor
Toggle the behavior in plugin settings
extras: The README notes this intentionally deviates from CommonMark, and the manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This intentionally deviates from CommonMark by neutralizing indented code blocks.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown parser turns any line starting with 4+ spaces or a tab into an indented code block, so typed indentation cannot be kept as plain visible indentation.
summary: Editor plugin that disables indented code blocks in Live Preview by inserting an invisible character before tabs or 4+ spaces of indentation.
